scope: W06 persistent Java Worker implementation inventory
method: read-only installation, process, socket, javap, and local COMSOL 6.4 documentation inspection; no ModelUtil.connect or model operation was issued

environment.os: macOS Apple Silicon (host architecture was not re-probed in this inventory)
environment.comsol_version: 6.4 installation; exact build inherited from prior W02 evidence, not re-queried here because the launcher version command was sandbox-blocked

server_observation.ownership: pre-existing dedicated Phase 1 server; this inventory did not connect to, stop, restart, or otherwise control it

ModelChangedHandler.documented_limit: By default notification is for another client modifying a model in use by this client; it is not an atomic compare-and-swap primitive.

model_identity_and_mutation: Model.tag(), Model.label(), Model.getFilePath(), Model.location(), Model.locationUri(), Model.timeModified()
study: No cancellation method was present in the inspected Study interface.

official_documentation.source: COMSOL 6.4 Programming Reference Manual, PDF page 44, KB chunk 10799, sha256 5b7f23ad2eae77f59d71935f4f6c9b6b9ede380dc34da065181841e512bbc105
official_documentation.finding: Several clients may connect, but only one client at a time can ask the server to perform an operation; ServerBusyHandler controls wait behavior.

official_documentation.source: COMSOL 6.4 ModelChangedHandler API, KB chunk 23166, sha256 97bdb9987b6f6c9d7d855385d67f3d9408fdb28a7c51469e61786dfb53e1fe0a
official_documentation.finding: The handler is called when another client changes models in use by the registering client; ModelChangeInfo exposes changed tags.

official_documentation.source: COMSOL 6.4 ModelUtil API, KB chunk 23171, sha256 a5e4c080407a673a5dd78e95b9fb089d92c0f518477ffdcc4f62b3348085c4eb
official_documentation.finding: blockOtherClients has no timeout and must be released by the requester; a disconnect releases it automatically.

serialization_and_external_change_eviden.implementation_consequence: Use one worker queue per server, including reads that enter the engine. Register ModelChangedHandler after connect, maintain generation/revision outside COMSOL, and use blockOtherClients only for short authorized critical sections with finally release and watchdog evidence.

ipc_dependency_check.available_in_apiplugins: COMSOL API/client jars listed by comsolclientpath.txt
ipc_dependency_check.observed_elsewhere_in_install: Jackson 2.13.4 jars exist under plugins/, not in comsolclientpath.txt
ipc_dependency_check.decision: Do not depend on COMSOL-bundled Jackson for the Worker protocol and do not copy commercial installation jars into this repository. Use a small repository-owned line-delimited JSON codec or a separately declared redistributable dependency after license review.

legacy_surface.current_backend: Python MPh client with direct JPype/Java access stored in global _client/_current_model.
legacy_surface.risk: A Worker that offers only parameter/study/save methods cannot transparently preserve all legacy wrappers, because many wrappers directly navigate arbitrary COMSOL model nodes.

minimum_worker_protocol_recommendation.transport: persistent localhost stdio or Unix-domain-socket child process with per-launch secret; newline-delimited JSON frames and bounded frame size
commands: engine_call with a closed, versioned internal operation set
minimum_worker_protocol_recommendation.routing: Retain legacy MCP names as Python compatibility wrappers, but route every COMSOL touch through the same server-keyed Worker queue. The internal engine_call set must initially cover the existing wrapper families (model tree, parameters, geometry/features, physics/variables/selections, solver/study, numerical evaluation, and save) rather than expose an external generic reflection/code API; external generic operations remain W08/W10 scope.
minimum_worker_protocol_recommendation.timeouts: Control process enforces RPC and queue deadlines. Worker records execution/no-progress observations; an execution deadline only transitions job to RUNNING/UNKNOWN/RECONCILING and must never interrupt or kill a shared server.
minimum_worker_protocol_recommendation.revisions: Before writes, compare expected revision and the current Worker model fingerprint/generation. ModelChangedHandler invalidates cached revision on changed tags; a post-write readback produces revision_after. This detects observed external changes but does not claim COMSOL-side atomic CAS.
